description: The plot illustrates the relationship between a variable represented on the x-axis and perplexity (PPL) on the y-axis, with multiple lines representing different conditions. The x-axis is labeled “”, has a linear scale, ranges from 2K to 64K, and has tick labels at 2K, 4K, 8K, 16K, 32K, and 64K. The y-axis is labeled “PPL”, has a linear scale, ranges from 7.7 to 8.2, and has tick labels at 7.7, 7.8, 7.9, 8.0, 8.1, and 8.2. A blue line, marked with circular data points, starts at approximately 8.2 at 2K and decreases to approximately 7.82 at 64K, with a local minimum of approximately 7.84 at 4K. An orange line, marked with circular data points, begins at approximately 8.15 at 2K and decreases to approximately 7.76 at 64K, with a local minimum of approximately 7.82 at 4K. A green line, marked with circular data points, starts at approximately 8.18 at 2K and decreases to approximately 7.73 at 64K, with a local minimum of approximately 7.78 at 16K.
